assets.what: Character sprite sheets (idle, breathing, blink, talking, walking, turning; four directions), sheets of people at rest (sitting, lying), sheets with a torn hem, and overlay sheets of story marks (bandages, the spare cloak, a water skin, a lamp, a rolled cloak, a letter case, a lamb carried across the shoulders), with their cast-shadow sheets, for morning, later-day and indoor light, overcast light (under rain cloud), lamp-light (at lamp-lighting, and a house lit by its lamps at night) and moonlight (Chapter 3 adds a newborn lamb held in the arms or the lap, a lamp held up with its flame lit after dark, and a wax tablet; Chapter 2's fishing folk carry an oar or a folded net).
assets.origin: Rendered offline with Blender 5.2 (Cycles) by tools/art/build_people.py. Each person is built procedurally from the game's character appearance data (tools/art/lib/people.py): a body grown along a joint skeleton, lofted garments, head and face parts, carried things and story marks, and our own forward kinematics and skinning for every pose. Overlays are rendered with the body as a holdout.

Heads are sculpted in code as signed distance fields (tools/art/lib/portrait_head.py); skin maps and shaders, eyes, hair (Blender hair curves), wound and draped cloth and the backdrop are procedural (tools/art/lib/portrait*.py).
